summary_en: Payout ratio target raised to 50% (medium-to-long term). DOE (dividend payout ratio on equity) floor set at 5%. Semi-annual dividend structure introduced (interim + final). Dividend forecast revised upward for FY3/27.
title_en: Notice Regarding Change in Dividend Policy (Setting Target Payout Ratio and Introduction of DOE Metric, Implementation of Semi-annual Dividend) and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: On 14 August 2026, Hammock Inc. announced a change to its dividend policy and a revision to its FY3/27 dividend forecast. The company introduced a medium-to-long-term target payout ratio of 50% and a new DOE (dividend payout ratio on equity) floor of 5% to provide more predictable shareholder returns independent of earnings volatility. The company simultaneously restructured its dividend distribution from annual to semi-annual (interim dividend as of 30 September each year and final dividend), effective from FY3/27. The rationale reflects the company's dual commitment: aggressive growth investment in AI-driven security solutions and AssetView product expansion, combined with enhanced shareholder returns, while maintaining a strong balance sheet and improving capital efficiency (ROE improvement) to exceed cost of capital. The company stated that despite planned growth capital expenditure, it retains sufficient cash generation capacity (supported by recurring revenue) to fund both strategic investment and a more generous dividend payout simultaneously.
